evidence: Classical scaling and reference geometry, with selected design conditions. No qualified vehicle, human tolerance, habitat design, wave climate, biological capacity or market forecast.
reading_rule: SI units; matched dry 301 K binary N2/O2 atmospheres. Compare equal mass, geometry and stated coefficients. Rotating-venue tolerances are chosen for illustration; the Moon comparison assumes a smooth spherical field and gives a maximum Coriolis magnitude. Water pressure is an apparatus constraint, never a human exposure limit. No monetary output is added.

venue.basis: Illustrative freely multidirectional venue. Axial width does not curve around the spin axis and axial velocity has no Coriolis term. Alternative layouts can relax requirements; no habitat mass or price is inferred.

water.basis: Chosen constant reference density and arbitrary apparatus absolute-pressure budget, equal on both worlds; not a water-property fit at 301 K or diving limit.

waves.basis: Infinitesimal gravity waves, still water, equal wavelength and depth. No wind, viscosity, breaking, currents or surface tension; no surf-ride or safety prediction.
